title: Invariant preservation and step decrease
statement: Let $z$ and $S$ be bit strings, and suppose there are bit strings $a,r$ such that $S$ is the pair encoding of $a$ and $r$, $a$ is the binary bit list of its own value, and the value of $a$ plus the length of $r$ equals the length of $z$. After one counting step, these properties still hold; if the decoded second component of $S$ has positive length, its length strictly decreases, and if it has length zero, the step leaves $S$ unchanged.
